# CALCIO

> Your company grew. Your systems didn't. CALCIO audits technical debt, rescues stalled software projects, and provides fractional CTO leadership for B2B growth-stage companies.

## About
CALCIO (CALCIO DEV LLC, registered in New Mexico, USA) is a software studio led by Juan Manuel Zaragoza. We build, automate and rescue software for companies that have outgrown their systems. We work in English and Spanish, in UTC-5, overlapping US business hours. When an engagement ends, the client owns everything: code, infrastructure, accounts and documentation.

## Services
- Architecture & Technical Debt Audit (anchor offer): a two-week, fixed-scope review of architecture, security, testing, CI/CD, dependencies, scalability and multi-tenancy, with a prioritized roadmap. USD 4,000–6,000, credited toward a follow-up engagement.
- Project Rescue: take over half-built or abandoned software, recover code and account ownership, and ship to production.
- Fractional CTO: technical leadership without a full-time hire — roadmap, architecture decisions, team coordination and hiring.
- Custom Software & Integrations: bespoke systems, APIs, integrations (ERP, CRM, legacy), payments and subscriptions with Stripe.
- Embedded Analytics & BI: dashboards inside the product with per-customer isolation (Apache Superset, BigQuery), automated reports.
- QA Automation & Release Confidence: testing from zero, E2E with Playwright, post-deploy quality gates.
- Applied AI: data agents, assistants and document parsing, only when it adds real value.

## Case studies
- Listing Los Cabos (real estate): rescued an inherited React + Firebase platform, added Stripe subscriptions, one codebase for two cities.
- High-volume ticketing platform in Spain: testing strategy from zero — 20 to 91 E2E tests, 616 backend integration cases, 3 payment gateways.
- Multi-tenant B2B data platform: NestJS backend, embedded Superset with per-client isolation, Superset migrated 4.1 to 6.1 in 30 days.
- Government of the City of Buenos Aires: ~7 years of technical leadership across 12 systems and 5 tech stacks.
- IVEE (veterinary): clinical histories trapped in PDFs turned into structured data in BigQuery with dashboards.
- New Condal (marketing, Barcelona): custom Apps Script connector pulling Google Business Profile data into Looker Studio dashboards.
